lucky.headerDescription: Classic survival with fair PvP, balanced economy and active community.
lucky.aboutDescription: LuckySurvival offers a classic Minecraft survival experience with fair PvP, a balanced in-game economy, and an active community. Built for both casual and competitive players
lucky.aboutDescriptionDesktopSuffix: — find your place in the world
lucky.aboutTargetMobile: Target: Balanced / chill players, active gameplay
lucky.aboutTargetDesktop: Target audience: Balanced / chill players who enjoy active gameplay, fair competition and economic strategy.
lucky.feature2Desc: Fair combat arenas and open-world PvP zones
lucky.feature3Desc: Buy, sell and trade items with other players

minewars.aboutDescMobile: MineWars is built for competitive players. Join ranked matches, seasonal tournaments, and team warfare. Every battle counts — prove you are the best.
minewars.aboutDescDesktop1: MineWars is built for competitive players who thrive in combat. Join ranked ladder matches, compete in seasonal tournaments, and rise through team-based warfare. Every battle counts — prove you are the best.
minewars.aboutDescDesktop2: The economy revolves around conquest — loot your enemies, claim resources, and hold your territory.
minewars.aboutTargetDesktop: Target audience: Competitive players, PvP enthusiasts, tournament-seekers
minewars.feature1DescMobile: Intense player vs player battles in arenas
minewars.feature1DescDesktop: Intense player vs player battles in dedicated arenas
minewars.feature2DescDesktop: Weekly and seasonal competitive tournaments with prizes
minewars.feature3DescDesktop: Climb the competitive ladder and earn exclusive rewards
minewars.feature4DescDesktop: Faction-based team combat and territory control
minewars.step4: Join a match or ranked queue!

calmsky.headerDescStart: A relaxed, peaceful server for building, exploring and enjoying Minecraft
calmsky.aboutDescMobile: CalmSky is a peaceful haven for builders. No PvP, no griefing — just creativity and collaboration. Join friendly build contests and share your creations.
calmsky.aboutDescDesktop1: CalmSky is a peaceful haven for players who want to focus on building, exploring, and community without the stress of combat. No PvP zones, no griefing — just creativity and collaboration.
calmsky.aboutDescDesktop2: Join friendly build contests, explore vast landscapes and share your creations with a supportive community.
calmsky.aboutTargetDesktop: Target audience: Casual players, builders, families, new Minecraft players
calmsky.feature1DescDesktop: Unlimited creative mode with premium WorldEdit tools
calmsky.feature2DescMobile: Vast unexplored worlds and custom biomes
calmsky.feature2DescDesktop: Vast unexplored worlds with custom biomes and structures
calmsky.feature3DescDesktop: Regular community build competitions with prizes
calmsky.feature4DescMobile: Claim your plot and build with neighbors
calmsky.feature4DescDesktop: Claim your own plot and build with neighbors
